overrides._comment_sharp: next 16.2.11 declares sharp ^0.34.5, and the libvips CVEs behind GHSA-f88m-g3jw-g9cj are only fixed in 0.35.0. Overriding rather than taking next 16.3.0, which is a minor and per AGENTS.md carries its own migration. sharp is an optionalDependency used only by the image optimizer, and next/image is used in zero files here, so the blast radius of forcing it is nil. Drop this override when next's own range reaches 0.35.
